description: List the results saved in your account (screening, EDD memo, exposure report or queue), or fetch one by its screening_id. Each list row gives the screening_id, tool, case reference, subject or first address, address count, headline status and save date. Read-only. Scoped to your account: needs sign-in (/mcp/account) or an API key. Free.

action.description: list saved results (the default), or get one by screening_id.

case_reference.description: For list: only results filed under this case reference.

limit.description: For list: how many results to return (default 20).

response_detail.description: summary (default) returns a short text summary for the model to read; the full result is always in structuredContent. full returns the whole result as JSON text.

screening_id.description: For get: the saved result's ID (its provenance screeningId).

tool.description: For list: only results from this tool.

name: saved_results

outputSchema.description: Structured saved-results response: a list of compact rows, or one stored record when fetched by screening_id.

accepts.description: Present when payment is needed: the x402 payment requirements to sign.

bucket.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: the limit that was reached.

error.description: Machine-readable error code when the tool fails.

found.description: For get: whether a saved result with that ID exists.

limit.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: the daily limit.

payer.description: Present when a payment was refused: the paying address.

price.description: Present when payment is needed: the price of the call without an account.

record.description: For get: the stored record, with its result.

caseReference.description: Case reference it is filed under.

tool.description: The tool that made the result.

remaining.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: how much was left.

resetsAt.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: when it resets (ISO 8601).

caseReference.description: Case reference it is filed under.

screening_id.description: ID of the saved result. Same value as savedId.

status.description: Headline status: the verdict status for a screening, the workflow status for a memo.

subject.description: The subject name, or the first address screened.

tool.description: The tool that made the result.

retryAfterSeconds.description: Present when the account made too many calls: seconds to wait.

screening_id.description: For get: the ID that was asked for.

support.description: Present on some errors: where to get help.

used.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: how much of it was used today.

x402Version.description: Present when payment is needed: the x402 protocol version.

title: Saved Results
